Counter loops use top: so goto iterations count. Do not also count boxed F/W forwarding wrappers. Stage-group counters. Single-worker non-atomic counters; runtime enable flag; no per-event clocks/allocation/rendering.
coverage: Single actual dispatch workers cover all current seed specializations of check.run, wnf.run, cmp.run and checker Map.find.
Book.set U worker covers F/W and direct U paths; other Book constructors/temporary updates are not claimed covered.
Map seek/put/insert specialized workers and roots counted separately as dispatches, not unique-node census.
Cur.steps and Cur.skip call U_Chk_dCur_dstep_dgo: count there only, not wrappers or aggregate helper loops.
Native String.eq/cmp and Map.bit use runtime bodies; counters assume these native macros enabled as in pinned seed.
limits: check_dispatch counts monadic-state computation, not completed unique proofs. Final check success plus job counters gates admission.
Syntax declarations may create multiple ordered Book events, so parser_decl_completed need not equal checker_jobs_built.
